simple.summary: מָעוֹךְ (Mâʻôwk) means Maok , a Philistine First listed occurrence: 1Sam 27 2.

definitions.full: H4582. Maok מָעוֺךְ proper name, masculine father of Achish of Gath (on form compare Lag BN 32 ); — 1Sam 27:2 ( ᵐ5 Αμμαχ , A Μωαβ , ᵐ5 L Αχιμααν ) = מַעֲכָה 1Kin 2:39 ( ᵐ5 Αμησα , A ᵐ5 L Μααχα ).
